title: Seasonal IoT & Blockchain Solutions Architect
description: Smart Village Technical College (SVTC) is seeking a Seasonal IoT & Blockchain Solutions Architect to oversee our summer student project lab in Smart Village. In this role, you will lead student teams in designing and optimizing decentralized software systems and integrating blockchain tech for IoT applications. You will deliver lectures on computer systems engineering, supervise parallel processing implementations in Java/C++, and guide teams through software project execution pipelines.
requirements: Experience working as an Assistant Professor, Teaching Assistant, or Senior Lecturer/Mentor in computer science or engineering.
Demonstrated professional project history or certification in Blockchain for IoT Applications.
Solid programming skills in Java, C++, and systems-level programming languages.
Proven track record as a Software Team Leader or technical project manager.
Bilingual proficiency in English and Arabic with strong technical presentation skills.
benefits: Modern research space at Smart Village Giza
Opportunity to collaborate on innovative IoT research prototypes
